channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Tech outages are fueling a new doomsday economy
item.description: Recent technology outages have left some worried about AI cyberattacks and the U.S. electricity grid. The doomsday economy is heating up as a result.

item.title: Pizza chains are under pressure. GLP-1 use is only one part of the problem
item.description: Domino's, Papa Johns and Pizza Hut face weaker demand, more delivery competition and changing eating habits, including GLP-1 use.

item.title: Quantum computing’s first real-world payoff may come in energy, not drug discovery
item.description: Quantum computing firms are testing energy-grid optimization, solar materials and hydrogen catalysts as they pursue practical uses.

item.title: Anthropic’s record IPO collides with tech’s worst week on Wall Street since 2020
item.description: Anthropic held its historic Nasdaq debut a day before Nvidia's stock closed out its longest weekly losing streak since 2008.

item.title: Saudi Arabia, Bahrain report new attacks as Iran says it remains open to a deal with U.S.
item.description: Saudi Arabia said it destroyed a drone launched by Iran-backed Houthis, while Bahrain said an industrial facility was hit by Iranian projectiles.

item.title: As prediction markets grow, so do the number of short sellers counting on DraftKings to fall
item.description: S3 estimates DraftKings short interest rose 17% since the NFL season began as prediction market volumes continue to march higher.

item.title: Trump says there could be a 'positive spin' from the latest FBI database hack
item.description: This would make the second recent intrusion into the FBI system.

item.title: S&P 500 correction: Five forces behind the market sell-off
item.description: The S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average closed in correction territory, off 10% from their records. The Nasdaq Composite lost its gain for the year.

item.title: Social Security benefits are rising in 2027, but other changes could affect what you keep
item.description: A 3.6% Social Security cost-of-living adjustment for 2027 will increase benefits across the board. But Medicare and tax changes will also affect retirees.

item.title: Top Wall Street analysts favor these 3 dividend stocks for strong returns
item.description: Wall Street analysts can help shortlist attractive dividend-paying stocks, as their recommendations are backed by thorough analysis of a company's financials.

item.title: International first class is over for U.S. airlines. Enter the mega business-class cabin
item.description: Airlines are opting to build giant business-class cabins with ever-more luxurious suites.

item.title: An ‘illusion of glitz and glamour’: Inside California’s modern-day gold rush, where miners can bring in millions
item.description: The price of gold has sparked a modern-day gold rush in California. Small-scale miners are investing time, physical labor and money to unearth the yellow metal.

item.description: Elevated options premiums are creating an opportunity in Amazon

item.title: State and federal battle over prediction markets regulation heats up after midterms
item.description: States, Congress and the CFTC are escalating the fight over prediction market regulation after the midterms.

item.title: Warren Buffett quadruples Thanksgiving gifts: A breakdown of how much wealth he's giving away
item.description: Warren Buffett more than quadrupled his Thanksgiving donations to four family foundations this year to $5.5 billion.

item.title: From trash to treasure: Most hated stocks are winning as AI bull market rolls over
item.description: Several stocks that are unpopular on Wall Street, including Clorox, Boston Beer and Campbell's, are poised to be winners as the AI trade loses steam.

item.title: 26-year-old Google worker earns $323,000 a year—but lives on less than minimum wage
item.description: Charles Broomfield set a post-college goal of reaching $750,000 in investments by age 30. Now 26, he expects to get there within the next year.

item.title: UN climate talks collapse as EU and others reject deal
item.description: Ireland's environment minister said the European Union could not support the proposed deal, in part because it made no mention of the fossil fuels.

item.title: I’ve studied over 200 kids—parents who do 6 things accidentally raise people pleasers: It starts in ‘ordinary, well-intentioned moments’
item.description: Reem Raouda, a conscious parenting coach who's worked with over 200 families, shares six habits worth reconsidering, like treating disagreement as disrespect.

item.title: The bull market has a new problem. The 'smart money' is selling
item.description: Companies are shifting from share buybacks to stock issuance, adding new supply. Anthropic’s $81 billion IPO puts that demand to the test.

item.title: During Wall Street's worst week in over a year, we put money to work. What we're buying
item.description: The brutal sell-off is creating opportunities for us to put cash to work.

item.title: Traveling soon? Here’s how to decide whether to fly or drive

item.title: I never wanted the American Dream and I felt like something was wrong with me—until I moved abroad

item.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Lutnick
item.description: President Donald Trump, when asked by CNBC's Eamon Javers, said he has not lost confidence in Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

item.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
item.description: Once the most valuable company in the world, Nvidia now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.

item.title: UK maritime agency reports two tanker attacks near Oman; Iran says vessel hit mine east of Hormuz
item.description: The incidents followed a similar attack on a tanker near Khasab on Friday that caused a fire on board, according to the British maritime security agency.
